# odinex_volume_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a volume to a server. The ID is the volume ID. Do not set `server_id` on the `odinex_volume` at the same time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "odinex_volume_attachment" "data" {
  volume_id = odinex_volume.data.id
  server_id = odinex_server.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server.
- `volume_id` (Number) ID of the volume.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the volume ID.
terraform import odinex_volume_attachment.data 12
```
